primitives.name: Field Access Control
primitives.verbatim_quote: No person other than the players, the officials, the representatives above mentioned or an incoming substitute shall at any time come upon the field of play.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A': 'set of authorized personnel (players, officials, representatives, substitutes)', 'F': 'field of play', 'T': 'time interval'}
primitives.assumptions: Only defined roles may enter field; unauthorized entry constitutes breach.

primitives.name: Coaching Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: (f) There shall be no coaching, either by substitutes or by any other persons not participating in the game.
primitives.assumptions: Coaching is restricted to participants; non-participants cannot influence gameplay.

layer2.mapping: Constraint function C(S ∪ P ∪ O) = 0 defines GSE action space; GSI computes penalty risk as conditional probability.

primitives.name: Injury Representative
primitives.verbatim_quote: In case of accident to a player one representative of the player's team may, if he first obtained the consent of the umpire, come upon the field of play to attend to the injured player.
primitives.assumptions: Representative access is conditional on umpire approval.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Unauthorized representative entry without umpire consent.
